notes: Autocol coder orientation v122 carries the confirmed v121 printed-artwork convention into the cold-glue servo generator. A mapped Autocol coder now uses the selected label's Code Box Ctr measurement from the physical printed LEFT edge, converts that artwork point through the machine-direction servo transform, inserts a legal Rest -> Correction -> Rest coder stage after the final wipe/roller motion, and holds the achieved code-box target through the coder and the 359 degree End of curve. The artwork location remains identical for left/right-hand and CW/CCW machines; only the servo plate command changes. The generator reports specific coder label, geometry, turn-window, and speed-envelope issues instead of moving the coder onto another table revolution. Includes v121 visual left-edge/code-box markers, v120 Autocol terminal policy, and v119 wipe-side parity.
